# HELM Legal — أحمد حلمي للاستشارات القانونية

Official public legal information website for Ahmed Helmy Legal Consultancy in the United Arab Emirates.
Primary language: Arabic (UAE). Public brand: HELM Legal.
Website: https://helm-protal.vercel.app/

- https://helm-protal.vercel.app/legal-services-uae — Legal services in the UAE
- https://helm-protal.vercel.app/legal-consultation-uae — Legal consultation in the UAE

- https://helm-protal.vercel.app/execution-uae — Judgment enforcement and execution

## Source policy
Legal content prioritizes official UAE sources, especially UAE Legislation, the Ministry of Justice and competent UAE judicial/government authorities. Content is general legal information; individual matters require review of the facts, documents, dates and applicable jurisdiction.
